# Slovko — Ukrainian Wordle Game (Словко)

> Free daily Ukrainian word-guessing puzzle game based on the Wordle mechanic. Guess secret 5-letter Ukrainian words in 6 tries with color-coded tile hints, dictionary lookups, and statistics.

## Main Pages

- [Play Slovko (Daily Puzzle)](https://alik532ua.github.io/Slovko/): Today's daily word challenge.
- [Practice / Unlimited Mode](https://alik532ua.github.io/Slovko/): Train vocabulary and play without daily restrictions.
- [Dictionary & Word Meaning](https://alik532ua.github.io/Slovko/): In-game vocabulary definitions from official Ukrainian explanatory dictionaries.

## Key Features

- Daily Challenge: One synchronized secret word every 24 hours for all players across the world.
- Rich Ukrainian Vocabulary: Curated lexicon of validated 5-letter nouns in nominative form.
- Text-to-Speech (TTS): Audio pronunciation of guessed words and definitions.
- Statistics & Streaks: Detailed victory counts, guess distribution, and winning streaks saved locally.
- Accessibility & PWA: High-contrast color palette, hotkeys, screen reader support, and full offline capability.

## Technical Details

- SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 runes architecture.
- LocalStorage privacy-first storage with zero telemetry of personal data.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/LLMO) & Schema.org JSON-LD WebApplication schema.
